findings.explanation: The SPL derives days_since_test from the latest event in the search window. With a 24-hour window a generator not tested for 30 days has no events, so it disappears and days_since_test > 30 never fires.
findings.quote: Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify a window longer than the test interval (for example 60 to 90 days) or a lookup of known generators, so missed tests appear.

findings.explanation: Validation is copied from PDU UCs; this UC reads generator test logs, not PDU SNMP.
findings.quote: Compare with the PDU UI or SNMP poll for the same devices, readings, and time range.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate by comparing last_test and result with the generator maintenance log or controller test history.

findings.explanation: The SPL also alerts when the last test result is not pass, which is the main point of the title and implementation (Alert on failed tests), but the description lists only the age condition.
findings.suggested_fix: State both conditions: last test result not pass, or no test in more than 30 days.

findings.explanation: Nothing says how generator:test events are produced (manual log input or BMS), or that they carry result and generator_id fields. A Universal Forwarder is not a modular input, and 617 is not in the cached Splunkbase catalog.
findings.quote: Generator controller logs, BMS events Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the event source, a sample event with result and generator_id, and the ingestion method. Verify the Splunkbase ID.

findings.explanation: Fuel level is not in the SPL or data sources of this UC; it belongs to the generator fuel UCs.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove it or refer to UC-15.1.8 and UC-15.1.12.

findings.explanation: The references are generic Splunk pages with nothing on generator testing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a generator test or maintenance standard the organisation follows, or vendor controller documentation.

findings.explanation: The scenarios are template wording (count, synthetic probe) and cite no real generator cause.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite real causes: a test performed but not logged, results logged under a different generator_id, and a generator out of service for maintenance.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Compares last_result to the literal pass; real controller or log values (PASS, passed, OK) may differ, so every generator could alert.

summary: A sensible stale-or-failed generator test check, but the scheduling guidance would stop it from ever firing on the 30-day condition, validation is copy-pasted from PDU UCs, and the data feed is undefined.
